name: UniFi-Protect-Backup
description: A Python based tool for backing up UniFi Protect event clips as they occur to cloud storage. By default it will backup clips locally to `/data` inside the container. However you can create an `rclone` config file to backup to dozens of cloud providers. You can do this by running the following commands: ``` $ mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/unifi-protect-backup/config $ docker run -it --rm -v /mnt/user/appdata/unifi-protect-backup/config:/root/.config/rclone --entrypoint rclone ghcr.io/ep1cman/unifi-protect-backup config ``` Use the interactive configuration tool to setup your desired backup destination. Once complete you can start the container ensuring that the `RCLONE_DESTINATION` uses the name of your rclone remote e.g `MyDropbox:/path/on/dropbx` NOTE: If you are using the `local` remote type, the path set in `RCLONE_DESTINATION` will be inside the container so please use `/data`. You then need to set the optional "Clip directory" below to where you actually want the data to be stored.

paths.name: Database directory
paths.description: Location to save the SQLite events database

paths.name: Clip directory
paths.description: ONLY USED WITH LOCAL RCLONE REMOTE

variables.name: TimeZone
variables.description: TimeZone for the container refer to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones for a list of possible timezones

variables.name: UniFi Protect username
variables.description: Username to login to Unifi Protect instance

variables.name: Verify SSL certificate
variables.description: Set to false if your UniFi protect instances doesn't have a valid SSL certificate

variables.name: Clip retention period
variables.description: How long should event clips be backed up for. Format as per the `--max-age` argument of `rclone` (https://rclone.org/filtering/#max-age-don-t-transfer-any-file-older-than-this)

variables.name: rclone destination
variables.description: `rclone` destination path in the format {rclone remote}:{path on remote}. E.g.`gdrive:/backups/unifi_protect`

variables.name: Ignore Cameras
variables.description: IDs of the cameras you want unifi-protect-backup to ignore. A list of camera IDs will be appear at the start of the log

variables.name: rclone args
variables.description: Optional arguments which are directly passed to `rclone rcat`. See the `rclone` documentation for the full set of arguments it supports (https://rclone.org/docs/)
